PITB’s objective is to standardise and harden enterprise connectivity and data-centre services across six regional offices by procuring, installing, configuring, and commissioning an integrated network stack—core/access switching, routing, and next‑generation firewalling—supported by structured cabling and fibre backbone, centralised monitoring/management, and a structured knowledge-transfer programme. Success, as we read the RFP, is measured by consistent performance and security across all sites, predictable operations for the PITB network operations team, and warranty-period service assurance backed by a responsive helpdesk.

We understand this is not a “box supply” exercise; it requires end-to-end delivery: validated design, staged implementation to minimise disruption, configuration baselining, acceptance testing, and handover documentation aligned to operational needs. We will apply the same disciplined delivery approach we have used on large network design and deployment engagements valued at PKR 44M, PKR 133M and PKR 182M, completed within the last five years [CAP-021][CAP-033][CAP-009]. Our delivery will be governed under our certified management systems (ISO 9001 and ISO 27001) [CO-PROFILE], and managed by PMP-certified project managers [CO-PROFILE].

We also note specific compliance and service expectations: 90‑day quote validity, bid security at 2% via CDR/bank guarantee, and documented high‑availability methodology with no single point of failure; we are positioned to support these requirements, including arranging bid securities from scheduled banks within our existing facility [CO-PROFILE].

Mandatory gap: our library does not yet evidence that all active equipment will be from a single OEM under a valid partner/reseller authorisation; we will address this by securing the required OEM authorisation prior to award and submitting it with the technical submittals [CO-PROFILE]. For items marked “partial” (OEM engineer certifications, centralised monitoring platform, and 24x7/4‑hour on-site response), our library does not evidence these; we will close them via OEM-certified resource assignment and an agreed support model during contract finalisation [CO-PROFILE].
